Study catalog

Source: vignettes/articles/studies.Rmd
studies.Rmd

Version française

Every study qesR can load: its design, population, size, licence and documents. qes_studies() and qes_docs() return the same information.

Code Year Family Study (DOI) Design Population n Licence Offline codebook
qes2022 2022 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2022 Pre- and post-election waves Canadian citizens aged 18+ residing in Quebec (online panel) 1,521 CC BY-NC 4.0 yes
qes2018 2018 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2018 Post-election cross-section Quebec population aged 16 and over 3,072 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2018_panel 2018 Durand election panel survey Panel Survey on the 2018 Quebec Election Panel Quebec adult population 1,250 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2014 2014 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2014 Post-election cross-section Quebec adult population 1,517 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2012 2012 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2012 Post-election cross-section Quebec adult population 1,505 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2012_panel 2012 Durand election panel survey Panel Survey on the 2012 Quebec Election Panel Quebec adult population 844 CC0 1.0 yes
qes_crop_2007_2010 2007-2010 CROP vote-intention polls CROP Polls on Quebec Provincial Vote Intentions, 2007-2010 Pooled polls Quebec adult population 24,027 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2008 2008 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2008 Post-election cross-section Quebec adult population 1,151 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2007 2007 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2007 Post-election cross-section Quebec adult population 2,175 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2007_panel 2007 Durand election panel survey Panel Survey on the 2007 Quebec Election Panel Quebec adult population 2,442 CC0 1.0 yes
qes1998 1998 1998 election polls 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CROP-CREATEC Panel Panel Francophone adult population of Quebec 1,483 CC0 1.0 yes
qes1998_crop 1998 1998 election polls 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CROP Panel Quebec adults interviewed in French 450 CC0 1.0 yes
qes1998_createc 1998 1998 election polls 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CREATEC Panel Quebec adults whose mother tongue is French 1,057 CC0 1.0 yes

n is the number of respondents in the data file. Not every study is a Quebec Election Study: the studies of the families Durand election panel survey, CROP vote-intention polls and 1998 election polls are listed under their own titles, and their designs and populations differ, so check both before comparing studies. The licences, and the attribution the 2022 study requires, are on Citing qesR and the studies.

By study

The Deposit line links to the deposit’s DOI. The document links download the file from Dataverse; qes_download() saves them in a folder you choose.

qes2022: Quebec Election Study 2022

  • Study: Quebec Election Study; Pre- and post-election waves; Canadian citizens aged 18+ residing in Quebec (online panel)
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/PAQBDR, Harvard Dataverse, version 1.1; licence Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 (CC BY-NC 4.0)
  • Data file: 2022 Quebec Election Study v1.dta (Stata data file), 1,521 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search()), under the study’s licence
  • Note: Two waves: campaign period (1,521 valid) and post-election recontact (1,220 kept), per the codebook’s methodological note. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2022")):
    • 2022 Quebec Election Study Codebook v1.pdf: Codebook, English, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2022")

qes2018: Quebec Election Study 2018

  • Study: Quebec Election Study; Post-election cross-section; Quebec population aged 16 and over
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/NWTGWS, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: Quebec Election Study 2018.dta (Stata data file), 3,072 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: Online post-election survey. Includes 251 respondents aged 16-17 (deposit note).
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2018")):
    • Quebec Election Study 2018 EN.doc: Questionnaire, English, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2018 FR.doc: Questionnaire, French, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2018 FR with programmed answer values.docx: Codebook, French, DOCX
    • Rapport méthodologique de l’Étude électorale québécoise 2018: Methodological report, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2018")

qes2018_panel: Panel Survey on the 2018 Quebec Election

  • Study: Durand election panel survey; Panel; Quebec adult population
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/XDDMMR, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: IPsos_oct_2018_17-057727_V.SAV (SPSS system file), 1,250 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: Ipsos panel, two waves, telephone and web (deposit metadata). Not a Quebec Election Study.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2018_panel")):
    • LivredeCodes_SondagePanelQC2018.pdf: Codebook, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2018_panel")

qes2014: Quebec Election Study 2014

  • Study: Quebec Election Study; Post-election cross-section; Quebec adult population
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/64F7WR, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: Quebec Election Study 2014.sav (SPSS system file), 1,517 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: Online post-election survey. The SPSS and Stata files hold the same data; the SPSS file is pinned.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2014")):
    • Quebec Election Study 2014 EN.doc: Questionnaire, English, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2014 FR.doc: Questionnaire, French, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2014 - Technical Report - Post-Election Study.doc: Technical report, French, DOC
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2014")

qes2012: Quebec Election Study 2012

  • Study: Quebec Election Study; Post-election cross-section; Quebec adult population
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP2/WXUPXT, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: Quebec Election Study 2012 (STATA).dta (Stata data file), 1,505 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: Online post-election survey, run with the Scotland Opinion Survey 2012 (deposit description). The Stata file is read; the SPSS file with the same UNF supplies labels.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2012")):
    • Quebec Election Study 2012 EN.doc: Questionnaire, English, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2012 FR.doc: Questionnaire, French, DOC
    • Rapport technique - Etude sur la politique - Quebec-Ecosse.doc: Technical report, French, DOC
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2012")

qes2012_panel: Panel Survey on the 2012 Quebec Election

  • Study: Durand election panel survey; Panel; Quebec adult population
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/RKHPVL, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: repondants_post_2012.sav (SPSS system file), 844 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: CROP telephone panel, two waves (deposit metadata). The file holds respondents who completed both waves. Not a Quebec Election Study.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2012_panel")):
    • Livre de codes - Panel Québec 2012.pdf: Codebook, French, PDF
    • Questionnaire-post_electionqc-2012_EN.docx: Questionnaire, English, DOCX
    • Questionnaire-post_electionqc-2012_FR.docx: Questionnaire, French, DOCX
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2012_panel")

qes_crop_2007_2010: CROP Polls on Quebec Provincial Vote Intentions, 2007-2010

  • Study: CROP vote-intention polls; Pooled polls; Quebec adult population
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/IRZ1PF, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: intvotetotal_juin2007_jan2010.sav (SPSS system file), 24,027 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: Monthly CROP telephone polls pooled in one file, about 1,000 respondents each (deposit metadata). Not a Quebec Election Study.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes_crop_2007_2010")):
    • LivredeCodes_SondagesCROP_2007-2010.pdf: Codebook, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes_crop_2007_2010")

qes2008: Quebec Election Study 2008

  • Study: Quebec Election Study; Post-election cross-section; Quebec adult population
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP2/8KEYU3, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: Quebec Election Study 2008 (SPSS).sav (SPSS system file), 1,151 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: Telephone post-election survey (deposit metadata). The SPSS and Stata files differ in UNF; the SPSS file is pinned.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2008")):
    • Quebec Election Study 2008 FR.doc: Questionnaire, French, DOC
    • Quebec Election study 2008 ENG.pdf: Questionnaire, English, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2008")

qes2007: Quebec Election Study 2007

  • Study: Quebec Election Study; Post-election cross-section; Quebec adult population
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP2/6XGOKA, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: Quebec Election Study 2007 (SPSS).sav (SPSS system file), 2,175 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: Post-election survey, telephone and web (deposit metadata). The SPSS and Stata files hold the same data (their UNFs differ); the SPSS file, whose labels are complete, is pinned. Both store most answer codes as text (“01”); qesR reads them as numbers.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2007")):
    • Quebec Election Study 2007 ENG.doc: Questionnaire, English, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2007 FR.doc: Questionnaire, French, DOC
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2007")

qes2007_panel: Panel Survey on the 2007 Quebec Election

  • Study: Durand election panel survey; Panel; Quebec adult population
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/NDS6VT, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: complet_tous_repondants_2007.sav (SPSS system file), 2,442 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: CROP telephone panel: two pre-election surveys, then a post-election recontact (deposit metadata). Rows are keyed by project and questionnaire number. Not a Quebec Election Study.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2007_panel")):
    • LivredeCodes_SondagePanel-QC2007.pdf: Codebook, French, PDF
    • Questionnaire_post-sondage-panel-electionqc-2007_EN.doc: Questionnaire, English, DOC
    • Questionnaire_post-sondage-panel-electionqc-2007_FR.doc: Questionnaire, French, DOC
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2007_panel")

qes1998: 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CROP-CREATEC Panel

  • Study: 1998 election polls; Panel; Francophone adult population of Quebec
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP2/QFUAWG, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: Total_panel_election_QC1998.sav (SPSS system file), 1,483 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: The panel file combining the CROP and CREATEC polls (1,483 valid questionnaires), each with a pre- and a post-election wave by telephone. Francophones only: the codebook says it was decided to keep only francophones (« retenir uniquement les francophones »); the exact definition used for the pooled file is pending. Not a Quebec Election Study.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes1998")):
    • LivredeCodes_Panel_QC1998.pdf: Codebook, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes1998")

qes1998_crop: 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CROP

  • Study: 1998 election polls; Panel; Quebec adults interviewed in French
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP2/QFUAWG, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: Total_sondages_election_CROP1998.sav (SPSS system file), 450 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: CROP file: pre-election poll of 450 respondents interviewed in French and its post-election wave, which kept only respondents whose language of use is French (N=426), per the codebook description. Undecided respondents, those who said they would spoil their ballot and those who refused to reveal their vote were oversampled.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes1998_crop")):
    • LivredeCodes_CROP_1998.pdf: Codebook, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes1998_crop")

qes1998_createc: 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CREATEC

  • Study: 1998 election polls; Panel; Quebec adults whose mother tongue is French
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP2/QFUAWG, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: Total_sondages_election_CREATEC1998.sav (SPSS system file), 1,057 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: CREATEC file: telephone pre-election poll of 1,057 respondents whose mother tongue is French and its post-election wave; undecided and refusing respondents were oversampled. The deposit recommends the weight ponderc (codebook and file descriptions).
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes1998_createc")):
    • LivredeCodes_CREATEC_1998.pdf: Codebook, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes1998_createc")

qes_cite() gives the citation of each study; see Citing qesR and the studies.
